offers_products.reason: Licenses and hosts software such as APX, portfolio management, accounting and pharmacy benefit platforms, plus virtual data rooms.

offers_services.reason: Provides outsourced fund administration, transfer agency, back-office processing, class action claims and managed IT services.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Customers are asset managers, banks, insurers, health plans and funds, not individual households.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells to investment managers, hedge funds, banks, insurers and health plans.

recurring_revenue.reason: Multi-year outsourcing contracts and software subscriptions with fees tied to ongoing fund administration and platform use.

cyclical_demand.reason: Mission-critical fund operations and benefit processing are embedded and hard to cut in downturns.

big_ticket.reason: Ongoing fees for administration and software subscriptions, not large one-off purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Value comes mainly from its proprietary software platforms, though paired with outsourced operations staff.

large_customers.reason: Serves large financial institutions, including 39 of the top 50 banks, big asset managers and health plans.

asset_heavy.reason: Software and outsourced services business; needs offices, data centers and people, not heavy plants or fleets.

notes: Mix of software and outsourced services; both are main offerings.
